title: matelea shortii
intro: Matelea shortii, commonly known as the Short's Swallowwort, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Matelea shortii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. Further studies are needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Matelea shortii as a medicinal plant.
